label: First Vatican Council, Dei Filius Ch. 3…… supports Only GOD_4 can reveal with the signs in…
note: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 2: miracles and prophecies clearly show God's omnipotence and infinite knowledge and are most certain signs of revelation. That only God can give these signs (they exceed every created power) is the analyst's reading of 'clearly show omnipotence'; the council does not state exclusivity in these words.
